summary.intent: Fix the injection tab in the memory loop TUI so it tests against all active memories and shows clear inject/skip status instead of raw scores. Then remove skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands, keeping only summary and memory-loop.
summary.outcome: The injection tab was updated to use PreviewSelection instead of SelectRelevant, showing INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons for each memory. Two new tests were added and all 22 tests passed. The commit was made. The command removal was planned but not yet executed (transcript ends at plan stage).

repo: PreviewSelection returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped fields (with skip reasons), while SelectRelevant only returns matched memories — PreviewSelection is the right API for showing full injection decision context.
The memorylooptui package has tab_injection.go, root.go, messages.go, and render_test.go as the key files for the injection tab feature.
explanatory_insights.go is a hook handler, not a command, and must be preserved even when removing related commands.
skilldb and skilltui are separate subdirectory packages under cmd/entire/cli/.

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was changed to carry a full SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches.
Switched from SelectRelevant() to PreviewSelection() to get the full report including skipped memories.
View updated to show summary line ('N would inject, M skipped'), INJECT label for matched memories, and SKIP label with reason for skipped memories. Raw scores removed.
Setting activeTab field in tests but then calling injectionTab.view() directly caused unusedwrite lint warning — fixed by removing the unused field assignments.

workflow: The 'RECENT INJECTIONS' section containing 'Injection Detail' caused a false positive in a test asserting absence of 'INJECT' substring — test assertions on substrings must account for section headers.
unusedwrite lint fires when struct fields are set but the struct method is called directly rather than through the parent — remove unused field writes rather than suppressing the lint.

friction: ExitPlanMode was interrupted twice by the user before the plan was finalized, requiring re-entry.
A test assertion for empty state failed because 'RECENT INJECTIONS' header contained 'Injection' which matched the absence check for 'INJECT' — required a test fix after the initial run.
unusedwrite lint warning required a second test edit after lint check revealed the issue.
open_items: Removal of skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands and related code (skilldb, skilltui, permissions subdirectories) — plan was written but implementation not started in this session.
